text: I'm with my nephew, he's 4 months old. Thermometer says 39.3 but when I hold his hands they feel like he's been outside in the snow, same with his little feet, and his whole body keeps doing these shivers. I don't understand how he can be that hot and feel like ice. It's not a fit, there's no jerking or anything like that, I've watched him the whole time. His mum's on her way back but I'm scared, what do I do
